displayName: DiamondEcho SRE: TLS certificate expires within 14 days

documentation.subject: DiamondEcho: a certificate is close to expiry and has not been renewed
documentation.content:
An uptime check reports that the certificate it was served expires in less than 14 days. Cloudflare (diamondecho.com, staff.diamondecho.com) and Google (the run.app address) renew these on their own; one this close to expiry means renewal has stopped. When it expires, browsers show visitors a security warning instead of the site.

The GitHub monitor warns earlier (21 days, scripts/sre/checks/tls.mjs); this is the independent backstop.

What to do: follow docs/sre/runbooks/tls-certificate.md.

This message carries no visitor data.
